articles.title: How to prepare GSTR-1 from your saved bills
articles.summary: Prepare GSTR-1 tables (B2B, B2CS, notes, HSN summary) from bills saved in Nivesh Sahayak, fix the warnings, and download the JSON for the GST portal.

articles.title: How to make GSTR-1 from a Tally, Busy or Excel file
articles.card: GSTR-1 from a Tally or Excel file
articles.summary: Drop a sales register from Tally, Busy, Marg or Excel, or Tally Day Book XML: check the rows listed, then download the GSTR-1 JSON or the offline tool Excel.

articles.title: How to match e-invoices, GSTR-1 and your books
articles.summary: Drop the e-invoice download, GSTR-1 and your Tally, Busy or Excel sales register: see invoices missing in one or different in value, tax, GSTIN or date.

articles.title: GSTR-1 upload: JSON or the offline tool
articles.card: JSON upload or the offline tool
articles.summary: Two ways to put your Nivesh Sahayak GSTR-1 on the portal: upload the JSON directly, or use the Excel workbook or CSV files in the GST Returns Offline Tool.
